name: Color8
description: Returns a Color constructed from red (r8), green (g8), blue (b8), and optionally alpha (a8) integer channels, each divided by 255.0 for their final value.

name: assert
description: Asserts that the condition is true.

name: char
description: Returns a single character (as a String of length 1) of the given Unicode code point code.

name: convert
description: Converts what to type in the best way possible.

name: dict_to_inst
description: Converts a dictionary (created with inst_to_dict()) back to an Object instance.

name: get_stack
description: Returns an array of dictionaries representing the current call stack.

name: inst_to_dict
description: Returns the passed instance converted to a Dictionary.

name: is_instance_of
description: Returns true if value is an instance of type.

name: len
description: Returns the length of the given Variant var.

name: load
description: Returns a Resource from the filesystem located at the absolute path.

name: ord
description: Returns an integer representing the Unicode code point of the given character char, which should be a string of length 1.

name: preload
description: Returns a Resource from the filesystem located at path.

name: print_debug
description: Like print(), but includes the current stack frame when running with the debugger turned on.

name: print_stack
description: Prints a stack trace at the current code location.

name: range
description: Returns an array with the given range.

name: type_exists
description: Returns true if the given Object-derived class exists in ClassDB.
